pilot_actions.name: Fly/Move
pilot_actions.description: Perform standard piloting maneuvers to move the ship through space. This includes basic navigation, course corrections, and maintaining flight patterns.

success: Ship moves according to pilot's intentions
triumph: Perfect maneuver grants advantage on next attack

pilot_actions.name: Evasive Maneuvers
pilot_actions.description: Execute complex evasive patterns to avoid enemy fire and make the ship harder to hit. Requires skill and puts strain on the ship's systems.

success: Upgrade difficulty of all attacks against ship by 1
Effect lasts until end of pilot's next turn
triumph: Perfect evasion - no system strain cost

pilot_actions.name: Full Throttle
pilot_actions.description: Push the ship beyond its normal limits, increasing speed at the cost of system strain and control.

success: Ship's speed increases by 1 for 3 rounds
advantage: Maintain better control at high speed

pilot_actions.name: Stay on Target
pilot_actions.description: Maintain perfect tracking on a target, making subsequent attacks more accurate but making the ship vulnerable.

success: Next attack against target gains +2 to hit
Effect lasts until end of pilot's next turn

gunner_actions.name: Fire Weapon
gunner_actions.description: Fire a ship-mounted weapon system at a target. Requires proper targeting and weapon operation.

success: Normal damage if target is hit

gunner_actions.name: Acquire Lock
gunner_actions.description: Use targeting systems to gain a weapon lock on a target, improving accuracy of subsequent attacks.

success: Lock lasts until end of gunner's next turn
advantage: Can share lock with other gunners

gunner_actions.name: Overcharge Weapon
gunner_actions.description: Push a weapon system beyond normal limits for increased damage, but risk system damage.

success: Weapon cannot be fired next round

systems_operator_actions.name: Angle Deflector Shields
systems_operator_actions.description: Reroute power to reinforce one shield zone while weakening others, providing tactical defense options.

success: Effect lasts until end of operator's next turn
triumph: Perfect shield angle - +3 to chosen zone

systems_operator_actions.name: Boost Systems
systems_operator_actions.description: Temporarily enhance ship systems by rerouting power, improving performance at the cost of system strain.

systems_operator_actions.name: Emergency Repair
systems_operator_actions.description: Quickly repair damaged ship systems during combat, restoring functionality at the cost of strain.

commander_actions.name: Coordinate Crew
commander_actions.description: Use leadership and tactical knowledge to coordinate crew actions, improving overall ship performance.

success: All crew gain +1 to their next action
Ship gains +1 to next defense check
Effect lasts until end of commander's next turn
triumph: Perfect coordination - +2 to all crew actions

commander_actions.name: Tactical Analysis
commander_actions.description: Analyze the battlefield and enemy movements to provide tactical advantages to the crew.

triumph: Perfect analysis - +2 to all combat rolls

commander_actions.name: Inspire Crew
commander_actions.description: Use charisma and leadership to inspire the crew, improving morale and performance under pressure.

triumph: Perfect inspiration - all crew recover 4 strain
Crew gain advantage on next action

copilot_actions.name: Assist Pilot
copilot_actions.description: Work with the pilot to improve ship handling and maneuverability through coordinated effort.

success: Pilot gains +2 to next Piloting check
Effect lasts until end of co-pilot's next turn
triumph: Ship gains advantage on next maneuver

copilot_actions.name: Secondary Weapons
copilot_actions.description: Operate secondary weapon systems or assist with primary weapons to provide additional firepower.

success: Can target different enemy than primary gunner
